The '''Sand Slug''', also known as the '''Giant Slug''' or '''Space slug'''<ref name="Hint Book">''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]''</ref>, was a [[Color/Legends|blue]] creature that could be found inside caves on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="NP">{{StoryCite|story=Star Wars (article)|book=Wikipedia:Nintendo Power|bformatted=''Nintendo Power'' Vol. 28|sformatted=''Star Wars''}}</ref> [[Crawler Cavern]] was known to be home to many Sand Slugs.<ref name="NP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The manual for the [[1991]] [[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game]] named these creatures "Giant Slugs." In an [[Star Wars (article)|article]] in an issue of [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Power|''Nintendo Power'']], however, they were called Sand Slugs, while the ''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]'' called them "Space slugs."
